To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
not really - i think each idea you discussed with josh seems great, especially the creator cohorts

To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh

tomorrow's food security meeting, she may

To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
f candidates for trainina on how to monetize voutube

To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
his priority countries were in his first email.. Ukraine, a few a few others, LAC is also on the list. The reason for LAC is
also Marcela has been in direct senior level engagemetns with UT as well, and it makes on Josh's list as well.

To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
Ultimately, we need to select our priority countries for all of these effforts.. combo of bright spots / democratic openings,
priority for FO to pilot with all of these companies

To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
exactly. works for me, if josh has already weighed in. FWIW on this, i'm good with either bright spots or non-bright spots;
for an initiative like this, it may sometimes be better to emphasize closing spaces where outlets are strugglign to stay in
business
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:40:03 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
and influencers can provide an avenue. i'm going to reach out to LAC to start us off as a pilot. YT wants to pilot in 2
regions this year-I think it is a bit of a tall order for us with everything us going on
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:41:23 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
as in, 2 regions might be too many for us?
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:42:03 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
as in pilot in 2 regions, the creative cohorts by the end of this calendar year.. like in th enext 4 months!
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:42:07 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
you think we cna do that?
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:42:43 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
i mean. if we do 2, I'd do LAC and eastern europe, as we actually use YT there.. but again.. can we commit to that
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:42:59 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
but i am hoping to go to eastern europe in the fall. we shall see
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:46:13 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
i suppose i've no idea how much work a "region" entails for us
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:46:35 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
but i'm fine with starting with one, and if they really want to do 2, figuring out what that would require from us

[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:47:23 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
ok cool
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 9:48:21 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
on meta - I guess Brian will respond with the specifics on what we talked about. Let's see what they come back to us with.
But also - they are def not the only player in town. Last night, i was chatting with the Indonesia mission.. they do really
cool stuff... and their big problems are whatsapp under Meta and Tik Tok!
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 11:51:05 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
sounds good and totally true re: other platforms. we have our own homework from today, before brian gets back to us - i'll
end an email to the group tomorrow, but i think we're on hook to a) ain up moldova, zambia, and malawi "snapshots"
w we see Meta's presence b) ain uo a list ot actors that could do traininos it Meta tunded them. and c) send a listi
priority elections
[contact omitted] Johnny Walsh Tuesday, July 12, 2022 at 11:51:13 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
just glancing at my notes, might be missing something
